description: This file defines the 'SessionedJsonifiable' interface, which provides methods for retrieving JSON data, headers, session information, and factory methods for creating sessioned JSONifiable instances for various signal, error, response, and acknowledgement scenarios within the streaming gateway actor context.

classes.name: SessionedJsonifiable
classes.description: Interface providing methods for session-aware JSON data handling in streaming scenarios.

methods.name: getJsonifiable
methods.description: Returns the Jsonifiable instance associated with this sessioned JSON object.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the JSON object.

methods.name: retrieveExtraFields
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves additional JSON fields based on session and signal enrichment.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the StreamingSession if available.

methods.name: signal
methods.description: Factory method to create a sessioned JSONifiable for a signal.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Factory method to create a sessioned JSONifiable for an error.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Factory method to create a sessioned JSONifiable for a command response.

methods.name: subscription
methods.description: Factory method to create a sessioned JSONifiable for a subscription event.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Factory method to create a sessioned JSONifiable for a stream acknowledgement.
